{"sql":"WITH assignments AS (
  SELECT ea.user_id, ea.experiment_id, ea.variant, ea.assigned_ts,
         u.channel
  FROM experiment_assignments ea
  JOIN users u USING (user_id)
), outcomes AS (
  SELECT a.experiment_id, a.variant, a.channel, a.user_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT t.topup_id) FILTER (WHERE t.topup_ts >= a.assigned_ts) AS topups,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE t.topup_ts >= a.assigned_ts), 0) AS topup_eur,
         COALESCE(SUM(ct.amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE ct.txn_ts >= a.assigned_ts), 0) AS card_spend_eur,
         COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr_eur) FILTER (WHERE s.month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', a.assigned_ts)), 0) AS mrr_eur,
         COALESCE(SUM(ip.amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE ip.payout_ts >= a.assigned_ts), 0) AS incentive_eur,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ip.user_id) FILTER (WHERE ip.payout_ts >= a.assigned_ts AND ip.amount_eur = 10) AS users_paid_10_eur
  FROM assignments a
  LEFT JOIN topups t ON t.user_id = a.user_id
  LEFT JOIN card_transactions ct ON ct.user_id = a.user_id
  LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = a.user_id
  LEFT JOIN incentive_payouts ip ON ip.user_id = a.user_id
  GROUP BY a.experiment_id, a.variant, a.channel, a.user_id
)
SELECT o.experiment_id, o.variant, o.channel,
       COUNT(*) AS assigned_users,
       AVG((o.topups > 0)::INT) AS topup_user_rate,
       AVG(o.topup_eur) AS topup_eur_per_user,
       AVG(o.card_spend_eur) AS card_spend_eur_per_user,
       AVG(o.mrr_eur) AS mrr_eur_per_user,
       AVG(o.incentive_eur) AS incentive_eur_per_user,
       SUM(o.users_paid_10_eur) AS users_paid_10_eur,
       c.cac_eur
FROM outcomes o
LEFT JOIN channels c ON c.channel = o.channel
GROUP BY o.experiment_id, o.variant, o.channel, c.cac_eur
ORDER BY o.experiment_id, o.channel, o.variant;","rationale":"Compare experiment variants within each acquisition channel on post-assignment funding and value proxies alongside €10 payout cost and channel CAC; this can reveal channel-specific lift, but these fields do not directly measure net revenue or profitability."}
